name: 164investments/guesty-cli
what_it_holds: CLI for the Guesty property management API with OAuth token caching and rate limiting.
why_useful: Generic authenticated client to one's own Guesty portfolio; no public/market data. Named "164investments" suggests a real-estate-fund use, i.e. plausible internal ops tooling rather than research data.
themes: Property-management / channel-manager / PMS public data (Guesty, Hostaway, Lodgify, OwnerRez, Hostfully, Smoobu, Beds24, iCal feeds) and vacation-rental manager benchmarks
why_all: Generic authenticated client to one's own Guesty portfolio; no public/market data. Named "164investments" suggests a real-estate-fund use, i.e. plausible internal ops tooling rather than research data.

name: Awesome-Hospitality-Channel-Manager
what_it_holds: Curated link list (no data itself) of commercial channel-manager SaaS platforms (SiteMinder, Cloudbeds/myallocator, Cubilis, RateGain, D-EDGE, STAAH, eZee Centrix, HotelRunner, RoomCloud) and open-source integration code (QloApps, frappe/hospitality, ilgala/laravel-wubook, ChannexIO/php-sdk, vBridge/laravel-icalendar). Mentions industry market sizing (~$1.1-1.8B) with no citation. No datasets.
why_useful: Map of who the channel-manager vendors are and which have API SDKs, useful as a lead list if the team later wants to pull benchmark blog data from a vendor site (e.g. Cloudbeds/AirDNA market reports), but nothing pullable here itself.
time_coverage: n/a (link list, current as of repo)

name: Hostaway-PHP-SDK
what_it_holds: PHP SDK wrapping the Hostaway PMS REST API (listings, reservations, calendars, financials). No committed data; requires a paid Hostaway account + API credentials to pull anything.
why_useful: Would let a Hostaway-subscriber host or partner pull realised occupancy/ADR by property if the team ever gets access to a Hostaway account; not usable without credentials the team doesn't have.
themes: Property-management / channel-manager / PMS public data (Guesty, Hostaway, Lodgify, OwnerRez, Hostfully, Smoobu, Beds24, iCal feeds) and vacation-rental manager benchmarks

name: guesty-client

name: guesty-mcp-server
what_it_holds: 38 MCP tools exposing a connected Guesty account's reservations, listings, and financials to an AI agent. Requires the operator's own Guesty account credentials; no public data.
why_useful: Not usable for us without a Guesty account of our own; flagged only because it shows the shape of data Guesty exposes (occupancy, ADR, reservation pipeline) if we ever partnered with a manager willing to share access.
